method: Python 3 scanned every byte position in original __text. For each complete candidate encoding it decoded signed relative displacement with struct.unpack_from and compared the Python-calculated destination with the target.
limits: Candidate bytes can occur in data or unrecognized code; the zero-hit result is an absence of matching byte encodings, not a code-coverage claim.
FF-group indirect calls/jumps, computed code pointers, BSS/runtime tables, non-text paths, and loader behavior are outside this scan.
No runtime execution, template-state, or lifetime conclusion is made.
